title: Northern Ireland's most capped players
brief: Name the ten players with the most caps for Northern Ireland in full internationals, to the end of the 2026 World Cup.

notes.Keith Gillespie: Keith Gillespie is 11th with 86, just outside.
notes.Paddy McNair: Paddy McNair is 12th with 82 (at the end of the 2026 World Cup).
notes.Josh Magennis: Josh Magennis had 89 at the end of the 2026 World Cup; caps since then don't count here.

checks: Wikipedia's records page on 12 June 2026 and RSSSF (to 7 June 2026, Northern Ireland's last match before the cut-off) give identical figures. Transfermarkt's match data counted to 19 July 2026 agrees (Magennis 89, McNair 82) except Jonny Evans, 108 there against 107; 107 is used (4th either way).
